title: LookML and Malloy Semantic Modeling Documentation

sources.notes: Google Cloud Looker documentation for LookML projects, models, views, Explores, joins, derived tables, connections, Git versioning, and UI/query dependency on model definitions.
LookML dimension reference for declaring named scalar fields within views, naming constraints, primary keys, SQL expressions, and field parameters.
LookML measure reference for declaring aggregations, measure naming, measure types, joined measure requirements, primary keys, and measure-on-measure boundaries.
LookML join reference for Explore-to-view joins, generated SQL FROM/JOIN mapping, sql_on/foreign_key, join type, relationship, and symmetric aggregate boundaries.
LookML quick reference and license surface confirming Google documentation CC BY 4.0 and code samples Apache 2.0 unless otherwise noted.
Malloy basic guide for querying data, reusable data models, run syntax, source -> view query form, select/group_by/aggregate operators, and SQL comparison output.
Malloy source documentation for sources as reusable definitions containing computations, measures, dimensions, views, and join relationships over tables/views/queries.
Malloy query documentation for source plus view pipelines, stages separated by ->, group_by, aggregate, named sources, and generated SQL output.
Malloy repository identity describing an open-source semantic modeling and query language that uses existing SQL engines including BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Trino/Presto, and DuckDB.
